summary: Tested Drawlead OS enhancements: HR Admin Designations with employee count badges, BDE Tasks with time tracking (Start/Pause/Resume/Finish), and HR Portal Calendar with date detail panel. All features working correctly.

bde_tasks_time_tracking_start.details: Start button works, changes to Pause+Finish buttons, shows 'Running...' indicator

bde_tasks_time_tracking_pause.details: Pause button works, changes to Resume+Finish buttons, time is tracked
